profile.headline: Senior full-stack developer
profile.summary: Full-Stack software engineer experienced in all stages of the SDLC: requirements analysis, front-end development, back-end development, database design, and performance test engineering.  Delivered everything from cross-platform mobile apps and cloud-based APIs to Windows services and standalone console utilities.  Believes in solving key business and organizational problems with careful software design, focusing on great user experience and managing technical debt to produce maintainable solutions.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description: Skills: C# · Blazor · Software Development · Microsoft Azure · Azure DevOps Services

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
• Built an internal App Store for retail mobile apps using React and C#/.NET Core, running on Azure Web and API Apps
    • Mentored junior engineers on the team, focusing on effective collaboration, clean/maintainable code, and software design
    • Supported multiple partner teams with mobile app deployment
    • Wrote an Azure Function to support enterprise-wide app deployment
    • Implemented multiple GraphQL services to support integration between app store and other enterprise tools
    • Researched and integrated MS Intune APIs with App Store architecture
    • Re-platformed existing apps from MS Azure to AWS and from SQL Server to Aurora PostgreSQL

positions.title: IT Software Applications Developer
positions.description:
• Built a SQL Server-driven full-text search feature for Mackin’s ebook catalog
    • Wrote audiobook support for MackinVIA using Javascript and AngularJS and custom Cordova plugins to leverage native device capabilities
    • Implemented search connectors integrating with third-party products
    • Supported the Wordpress site for the marketing pages on mackin.com

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
• Built dynamic, database-driven websites using a variety of technologies including MySQL and SQL Server
    • Wrote a multilingual LMS/LCMS in Java/J2EE for the Ministry of Education in Oman
    • Developed LearnWithUS, an AIR application for creating modular SCORM-
      conformant Flash-based training courses.
​

positions.title: Security Officer
positions.description:
Maintained security at client facilities.
Monitored security cameras.
Patrolled parking lots and external ground, keeping logs of all security incidents.
Maintained the safety and security of visitors and staff.

positions.title: Program Coordinator
positions.description: Work with individuals with developmental disabilities providing community based supports. Responsibilities included teaching independent living skills, maintaining a clean and safe living environment, transporting individuals to activities and/or appointments.
